{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Number of unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total number of rows:", len(df))
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())"}
